title: Transferring encoded paths to the step relation
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $s,u\in\mathbb N$. Suppose a bit string $\gamma$ is reachable from the binary expansion of $u$ by a finite sequence of zero or more edges, each edge encoding a one-step transition of $N$ on input $x$ between configurations whose work-tape heads and contents lie within the window of radius $s$. If $\gamma$ is the binary expansion of some $c\in\mathbb N$, then $c$ is reachable from $u$ by zero or more steps of the corresponding encoded configuration relation with input $x$ and window radius $s$.

$\gamma$ is the binary expansion of $c$ for some $c\in\mathbb N$.
